excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]星系发现了大量的古代采矿无人机。看来这里是一个巨大的采矿与矿石处理中心，甚至可能是整个星系中最后一个类似的存在。
excerpt.en: We have encountered a significant Ancient Mining Drone presence in the [From.GetName] system. It appears to be a major mining and mineral processing hub, perhaps the last of its kind in the galaxy.
